title: "Finding bugs without running or even looking at code" by Jay Parlar
summary: Jay Parlar's Strange Loop talk shows how model checkers such as Alloy can find complex bugs in a system's design without running or reading any code. He walks through modeling architectures and checking every possible sequence of operations, including a real security bug and a UI feature-interaction bug.
why: HN commenters point to it as the best practical introduction to Alloy and to lightweight formal modeling.

quote.text: There is a talk that gives a good overview on Alloy and how useful using something like this is
